question: Evaluate: 12 ((1)/(2))% of 560 km + 66 ((2)/(3))% of 240 km
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Memorize common percentage to fraction conversions for faster calculation.

12 ¹/₂% = 1/8 and 66 ²/₃% = 2/3

⇒ Expression = (1/8) × 560 + (2/3) × 240

⇒ Expression = 70 + 160 = 230

**∴ The correct answer is 230 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

12 ¹/₂% of 560 km + 66 ²/₃% of 240 km

**Calculation:**

⇒ 12 ¹/₂% = 25/2 % = (25/2) × (1/100) = 25/200 = 1/8

⇒ 66 ²/₃% = 200/3 % = (200/3) × (1/100) = 200/300 = 2/3

Substituting the fractional values into the original expression:

⇒ (1/8 × 560) + (2/3 × 240)

⇒ 70 + 160

⇒ 230

**∴ The correct answer is 230 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Common Percentage-Fraction Equivalents

Memorizing standard equivalents saves calculation time: 16 ²/₃% = 1/6, 14 ²/₇% = 1/7, 33 ¹/₃% = 1/3, and 37 ¹/₂% = 3/8.

BODMAS Rule

Always follow the order of operations: Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication (left to right), Addition/Subtraction (left to right). The word 'of' indicates multiplication and is solved before division.

Percentage Reversibility

X% of Y is always equal to Y% of X. This property can be used interchangeably to make calculations easier when numbers are reversed.
